name: ABCO Miami
description: ABCO was created as a long-filler cigar built for everyday smoking. The “Miami” name is a nod to one of the most important cigar cities in the world - a place where generations of Old-World immigrants helped shape the culture of handmade cigars. It’s a small tribute to a big piece of cigar history.

name: American Sun Grown

Using 100% sun-grown Nicaraguan tobaccos, American Sun Grown was blended for everyday smokers seeking a bolder profile at a great value. When introduced, it quickly surpassed expectations-earning appreciation not just in the U.S., but around the world.

name: Black Market
description: Black Market began with a shipment of Panamanian tobacco, a rare leaf with a flavor so intriguing we couldn’t let it go. For more than a year, we built and smoked our way through 18 test blends, chasing the profile that would unlock the tobacco’s full potential. Each version got us closer, until one finally revealed the depth, spice and quiet sweetness we’d been searching for.

name: Black Market Estelí
description: Black Market Estelí was created to bring the source into focus. While the original Black Market leaned into mystery, this release shines a light on Estelí - the heart of Nicaragua’s cigar culture - and the intensity it brings to the blend. With a bolder profile and added complexity, it’s a sharper, more concentrated expression built for those who like their Black Market with more edge.

name: Black Market Estelí Diamond
description: Black Market Estelí Diamond was created to push the Black Market Estelí blend into a more technical, limited format. Built around a distinctive diamond press, the cigar required an additional leaf of Nicaraguan ligero to support the shape and intensify the experience, resulting in a bolder expression produced in limited quantities.

name: Blind Faith
description: Some cigars start with a plan. Blind Faith started with a belief that the right tobaccos would come together if we trusted the process. Built around rich Nicaraguan fillers from Estelí and supported by carefully chosen Honduran leaves, Blind Faith proves that sometimes the best blends begin with a little instinct.

name: Chunk
description: Who says size doesn’t matter? For those who like it short and stout, Chunk is for you. From the beginning, the Chunk size has been our answer to one simple idea: when the moment calls for more, give it more. Chunk Maduro carries that same mindset forward - bold, unapologetic, and built for smokers who know exactly what they want.

name: Chunk Shade
description: Chunk Shade is a mellow monster, ideal for shorter smoking sessions when you want a cigar that delivers a refreshing smoke and irreplaceable quality. Stout in nature and ultra-thick, Chunk Shade is the more approachable cigar in the Chunk series. Sporting the same bold shape as the other Chunks, Shade has a lighter cover leaf that brings a mellow and smooth profile for a relaxing smoking experience.

name: Connecticut
description: The Alec Bradley journey began in the 1990s with a humble Connecticut Shade cigar that defined the palates of its time. Alec Bradley Connecticut honors that original blend by pairing classic Connecticut Shade nuances with slightly bolder Honduran and Nicaraguan tobaccos. Mellow to medium bodied, it’s a Connecticut Shade crafted for the modern era.

name: Coyol
description: La Vega Coyol is a farm in Honduras, named for the majestic Coyol palm that stands at its entrance. Grown in the same fertile soil, its tobaccos develop rich aromatics and an exceptional palate experience. Like a fine wine, Coyol honors the land that shaped its character.

name: Do Not Disturb
description: Sometimes the best thing you can do is nothing at all. Do Not Disturb was created as an invitation to step away from the noise, the obligations, and the constant pull of the day. It’s a cigar meant for uninterrupted moments, when you silence everything else and give yourself the time you’ve earned to enjoy a cigar.

name: Double Broadleaf
description: Double Broadleaf was born from a simple question: what happens when you lean all the way in? As part of Alec Bradley’s Experimental Series, it pushes the idea of “more” by pairing a proprietary Connecticut Broadleaf wrapper and binder grown in Honduras with an additional Nicaraguan binder. The result is a bold, deliberate exploration of richness and balance: proof that experimentation, when done with purpose, pays off.

name: Filthy Ghooligan
description: Filthy Ghooligan is the darker, spicier cousin to Filthy Hooligan, released annually to mark the Halloween season. Built as a barber pole cigar with richer tobaccos and a bolder profile, it delivers a more intense take on the Hooligan tradition - made for nights when the lights are low and the mood leans darker.
filler: Nicaraguan Condega, Nicaraguan Esteli, Nicaraguan Jalapa, Dominican Piloto

name: Filthy Hooligan
description: Filthy Hooligan was created as Alec Bradley’s annual signal that spring has arrived. Defined by its bright green Candela wrapper and bold barber-pole presentation, the cigar is released once a year in limited quantities, offering a flavor profile and visual character that only comes around once.

name: Filthy Hooligan Shamrock
description: Filthy Hooligan Shamrock is the most intricate and refined expression of the Hooligan tradition. Defined by its rare triple barber pole construction, Shamrock brings together three distinct wrapper leaves to create a layered, visually striking cigar released once a year to welcome spring, in limited quantities.
wrapper: Honduran Candela, Nicaraguan Oscuro, and Nicaraguan Habano (Triple Barber Pole)

name: Gatekeeper
description: Gatekeeper represents a moment of entry. Partnering with Ernesto Perez-Carrillo opened the gates to new tobaccos, new techniques, and a deeper understanding of the craft for Alec Bradley. This cigar captures that transition - where experience meets curiosity, and the next chapter begins.

name: It's a Boy / Girl
description: Cigars have long been part of celebrating life’s milestones. It’s a Boy and It’s a Girl were created to mark the arrival of a new addition, offering a simple, traditional way to share the moment with friends and family in an approachable format.

name: Kintsugi
description: Kintsugi takes its name from the Japanese art of repairing broken pottery with gold, embracing imperfection rather than hiding it. For Alec Bradley, it became a symbol of how shared passion can bring people together and strengthen what might otherwise feel fractured. This cigar is our way of honoring connection - between makers, smokers, and the moments they share.

name: Kintsugi Wabi Sabi
description: Wabi Sabi is the second chapter in the Kintsugi story, inspired by the Japanese philosophy that finds beauty in imperfection, authenticity, and time itself. Rather than seeking polish or symmetry, it embraces character - the kind earned through experience and intention. Crafted in Estelí by AJ Fernandez, Wabi Sabi celebrates the quiet confidence that comes from accepting things as they are.

name: Lineage
description: Alec Bradley Lineage reflects the brand’s past while looking firmly to the future. This medium-bodied blend highlights proprietary Trojes tobaccos, delivering the depth and richness Alec Bradley fans expect. Lineage is proudly rolled by longtime partners at the Raíces Cubanas factory in Danlí, Honduras.

name: MAXX
description: The MAXX line was a bold departure from the norm. While smaller ring gauges dominated the market, we chose to push back-crafting large-format cigars designed to maximize flavor, balance, and value. By blending tobaccos from five different countries, we achieved depth and complexity that proves sometimes, bigger really is better.

name: Mundial
description: Mundial - meaning worldly - was the result of a six-year pursuit to create a cigar that reflected the full breadth of Alec Bradley’s blending experience. When the blend was finally complete, the brand chose to mark the moment in a way that matched the name: by launching Mundial into the stratosphere aboard a high-altitude weather balloon, making it the first cigar ever sent to the edge of space before returning safely to earth, ready to be smoked.

Rolled at Raíces Cubanas in Honduras, it reflects an Old World approach to balance and structure, expressed through New World tobaccos and modern blending - a reminder that excellence doesn’t belong to a single tradition.

Created as a tribute to Old-World cigar making traditions and rolled at Raíces Cubanas, it was built with intention, patience, and respect for the craft.
